errors.mediaInvalid: Upload the files with purpose KYC first (your own uploads only)
errors.mediaInUse: A file is already used by another KYC document
errors.duplicateMedia: The same file is sent twice
errors.notPending: Only pending documents can be forwarded
errors.duplicateType: Each document type can be sent once (use OTHER for extra documents)
errors.titleRequired: Give the OTHER document a title
errors.notDraft: Submitted documents can't be deleted: upload a new one of the same type to replace it, or ask an admin to remove an approved one
errors.nothingToSubmit: There are no draft documents to submit
errors.draftDeleteDirectly: This document is still a draft: delete it directly
errors.memberNotFound: Team member not found in your store
errors.onboardingLocked: KYC can only be edited by the store before the sign-up is sent to the admin

notification.submitted: A team member submitted KYC documents
